rust_summary:
client view hooks for PvP clients (`native_hurt_tilt`, `native_fire_overlay`,
`native_attack_reach`, `native_hand_pose`), the player's state as client mods read it
(`native_attack_strength`, `native_food`, `native_effect`, `native_equipped`, `native_max_damage`,
`native_item_count`, `native_item_cooldown`) and two per-frame view settings
(`native_set_fullbright`, `native_set_chat_background`).
doc_summary: client view hooks and the player's state for PvP client mods: `native_hurt_tilt(strength)` lowers the hurt camera tilt, `native_fire_overlay(lower)` draws the first-person fire lower (in flame heights), `native_attack_reach(distance)` tells a hit's reach from the eye, and `native_hand_pose(hand, stack, using, pose)` moves or scales a first-person item in its own space (drawing only). Helpers read the attack cooldown (`native_attack_strength`), food and saturation (`native_food`), active effects by index (`native_effect`, no allocation), worn and held stacks (`native_equipped("head"…"offhand")`, `native_max_damage`), carried counts (`native_item_count`) and item cooldowns (`native_item_cooldown`); `native_set_fullbright(on)` and `native_set_chat_background(opacity)` change the view for a frame without touching the options. Bundles need "hooks": @API:incari_client_hooks@.
